lines: Living in leggings, but want to look dressed?

clip.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 UGC-style fashion try-on video for social media, 15 seconds, four quick cuts, natural phone-camera look, bright warm apartment with wood floors, an arched mirror and soft daylight. The presenter is an AI-generated young adult woman (not any real person), friendly and excited, speaking English directly to the camera. Clear natural speech, light room tone, no background music, no on-screen text, no logos.
The dress in every shot is the exact burgundy chunky rib-knit turtleneck sweater dress from the reference images: loose slouchy fit that hangs straight from the shoulders with no waist seam, folded turtleneck, dropped shoulders, long full sleeves with ribbed cuffs, ribbed hem, mini length ending at upper-to-mid thigh. It is always worn over opaque black leggings (never bare legs). Keep its burgundy color, chunky vertical rib, turtleneck and short length identical to the references; never lengthen it toward the knee and never add a waist or belt.
Shot 1 (0-3 s): the presenter (shoulder-length wavy dark-brown hair, small gold hoop earrings) is already wearing the dress over opaque black leggings, sitting cross-legged on the couch holding a mug; she looks up at the camera, saying: "Living in leggings, but want to look dressed?"
Shot 2 (3-7 s): cut to her standing, mid-shot; she pushes up the slouchy sleeves and lets the loose knit fall straight from her shoulders, saying: "It's a loose, slouchy sweater dress with a folded turtleneck."
Shot 3 (7-11 s): cut to a full-length shot by the front door, now in black ankle boots; she grabs her keys and a tote bag, saying: "Add leggings and boots, and you're out the door dressed."
Shot 4 (11-15 s): she walks up to the camera into a smiling close-up, saying: "It's Ember and Clove, forty-four ninety-nine. Link's right here."
